Repo: jovlinger/utils, skills/projectmanagement/todos (todo.py, todo_web.py, SKILL.md).
Parent: 5b446160 (grooming backlog). This implements its item 1 (state renames) and
the state-filter half of item 3, plus the new requirements below.

GOAL
`todo ls` and `todo search` hide terminated states (done, merged) by default.
Implemented via -s handling + a new --states filter with a macro grammar.

A. DEFAULT HIDING + -s / --states MODEL (confirmed)
Filter precedence:  --states  >  -s (= ALL)  >  config default (ALL,-FINAL).
  - neither flag   -> config.json default filter (default ALL,-FINAL) -> hide done/merged; no State column.
  - -s             -> filter = ALL (unhide everything) AND render the State column.
  - --states=X     -> filter = X (State column shown, since states were named).
  - -s --states=X  -> filter = X AND render the State column.
-s keeps its current meaning of "show the State column" (today's _add_column_args)
in addition to lifting the default hide. Applies to BOTH ls and search.
NOTE: ls has no state filtering today; search has an optional --state (singular)
filter with no default -- both migrate to this model. Rename singular --state -> --states.

B. --states GRAMMAR
Mandatory value (comma list). Reuses the existing +/-/, left-to-right evaluation
(parse_state_filter): ',' and '+' = union, '-' = difference, evaluated left to right
AFTER inline macro expansion. Example: ALL,-done shows everything except done.
Default (no -s, no --states, no config override) = ALL,-FINAL.
Casing convention: concrete state names lowercase; MACROS uppercase, so a token is
unambiguously a state or a macro.
Macros:
  ALL       = every state
  FINAL     = done, merged        (hidden by default)
  PAUSING   = waiting, userneeded, stopped
  WORKING   = working             [OPEN: include ready? old 'run' alias = ready+working]
  UNSTARTED = groom, ready        [OPEN: ready boundary vs WORKING]
  INFO      = fact
N/a is a member of ALL only.
Replace the old lowercase aliases (all/todo/stall/run) with these macros
(default: drop them; optionally keep as deprecated synonyms).

C. config.json DEFAULT FILTER
Store the default filter expression under a new key in <basedir>/.todo/config.json
(same file as the storage DSN / version marker). Absent key -> built-in ALL,-FINAL.

D. STATE RENAMES + FACT (confirmed)
  pre       -> groom
  pre-init  -> groom     (both collapse into GROOM)
  init      -> ready
  info      -> fact      (migrate the info STATE to fact)
Add fact as a valid state: an informational todo that will never be worked; it exists
to harness vector-memory associative recall. fact is the sole State of such an "info
object". Principle (from parent todo): prefer nouns over gerunds.
Update VALID_STATES, mint/init/set defaults + help text, argparse choices lists, and
any TERMINAL/state-group references. Stored State keys stay lowercase (groom/ready/fact);
UPPERCASE is reserved for macros -- confirm final casing at implementation.
MIGRATION: renaming stored State keys needs a data migration for existing todos
(pre/pre-init->groom, init->ready, info->fact) via the migrate-to-latest framework
(schema_version / RECORD_MIGRATIONS), not an ad hoc pass. Both backends (sqlite + file).

E. SUBTODO_STATE_INFO IS A DIFFERENT NAMESPACE (do NOT conflate)
SUBTODO_STATE_INFO = "INFO" (todo.py ~1481) is a Subtodos back-link marker inserted by
`set --parent` (a follow-only HATEOAS link, excluded from merge-completeness) -- NOT a
todo's own State. The info->fact STATE migration MUST NOT touch these Subtodos INFO
markers. Verify no code path conflates the two before migrating.

F. SKILL UPDATES (SKILL.md + any skill references)
  - Document the new state vocabulary (groom, ready, fact + the rest) and the
    noun-over-gerund principle.
  - Document the selection commands: ls/search hide FINAL by default; -s shows all +
    State column; --states=<expr> with the macro grammar. Worked examples, e.g.:
      todo ls                                  # active work (FINAL hidden)
      todo ls -s                               # everything, with State column
      todo search foo --states=WORKING,PAUSING
      todo search foo --states=ALL,-done
      todo ls --states=FACT                    # browse the fact / memory corpus
  - FACT extra verification: when the skill/agent is asked to WORK a fact todo, it MUST
    pause and ask for explicit confirmation first (facts are memory anchors, not work
    items).

OPEN / TO CONFIRM AT GROOMING
  - WORKING/UNSTARTED boundary: does WORKING include ready? (default WORKING={working},
    UNSTARTED={groom,ready}).
  - Keep old lowercase aliases as deprecated synonyms, or drop (default: drop).
  - Final stored-state casing (lowercase assumed).
  - Should ls keep its current column-driven sort when a state filter is active?

ACCEPTANCE (tests)
  - ls/search hide done+merged by default; -s reveals them + adds the State column.
  - --states macro expansion + include/-exclude, left-to-right (ALL,-done etc.).
  - config.json default override honored; absent -> ALL,-FINAL.
  - Migration renames pre/pre-init->groom, init->ready, info->fact on both stores;
    SUBTODO_STATE_INFO markers untouched.
  - SKILL.md documents states + selection examples + FACT-work verification.

Summary.raw: todo ls/search hide FINAL (done,merged) by default: -s/--states macro filter, state renames pre/pre-init->groom, init->ready, info->fact (+ fact state), config.json default, skill updates
